title: Crispy Polish Flatbread
description: A crispy flatbread recipe inspired by traditional Polish cuisine, made with gluten-free bread. Enjoy as a snack or side dish.

ingredients.name: Polish bread
ingredients.notes: Crusty on the outside, soft on the inside

ingredients.name: Jucy meat (optional)
ingredients.notes: For added protein (cook separately to safe temperature)

instructions: Slice Polish bread into 1-inch thick slices.
Brush each slice with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and sugar.
Place bread slices on a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy.
While bread is baking, brush flatbread with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Place flatbread on a separate baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes or until crispy.
If using Jucy meat, cook separately to a safe internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
To assemble, place a slice of crispy Polish bread on a flatbread.
Add Jucy meat on top (if using) and serve immediately.
